title: Documents needed, in English: the validated answer, uploaded on the secure link only

knowledge.title: Documents requis
knowledge.keywords: documents, papiers, CIN, passeport, permis, licence, passport
knowledge.french: Pour chaque conducteur : sa pièce d'identité (CIN ou passeport) et son permis de conduire, valides jusqu'à la date de retour. Les photos se déposent en ligne, sur le lien sécurisé du site.
knowledge.english: For each driver: an ID card or passport and a driving licence, valid until the return date. You upload the photos online, on the secure link of the site.

turns.customer: Hi! What documents do I need to rent a car?

script.reply: For each driver: an ID card or passport and a driving licence, valid until the return date. You upload them on our secure link when you finalise your request — never on WhatsApp.
